title: Forge Log Record
description: A single diagnostic record emitted to stderr. One JSON object per line (NDJSON). See docs/reference/log-record-format.md and ADR-022.

level.description: Severity. One of the four levels defined by docs/reference/log-levels.md.

component.description: Subsystem tag. Closed enumeration; adding a value requires an ADR.

msg.description: Human-readable summary. Not stable; use attrs for machine-readable values.

correlation_id.description: UUID v4 identifying the invocation. Same value on every record of one invocation; zero UUID when not part of an invocation.

attrs.description: Structured key-value data. Free-form; keys are strings, values are JSON-serializable.
